posts.title: Tonic is joining the gRPC project
posts.description: Over the next week hyperium/tonic will become grpc/grpc-rust and we will publish a preview release of the new grpc crate. This marks a significant next step for the tonic project and for all gRPC users in Rust as it will be upstreamed to the official gRPC project . posts.title: Tonic: 0.1 has arrived!
posts.description: Tonic: 0.1 has arrived! tonic is a gRPC over HTTP/2 implementation focused on high performance, interoperability, and flexibility. It has been a few months since I originally released the 0.1.0-alpha.1 version. Since then there has been a ton of growth and improvements.
